periods.label: Week of August 10, 2026
periods.summaryTitle: New Swarm Mode and Combat Overhauls

features: Introduced 'Swarm Mode' playstyle featuring a realm-header toggle with countdown, tooltips, force queued enemies, and wave-scaled server cooldowns for dynamic challenge.
Revised status effects by ensuring Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks now bypass dodge mechanics.
bugfixes: Resolved graphical issues associated with blizzard spells.
balance: Overhauled status effect rules: Voodoo poison amplification scales significantly up to level 99. Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks now ignore player dodging and blocking.
Updated the Blocking mechanic by removing reactive cooldowns for consecutive block rolls and ensuring Penance restores a guaranteed minimum of 1% max Mana per successful block.
Adjusted defensive gear stats: Block chance caps are now set at 90% for specific pieces (buckler, Katar, Reflective Surge).
graphics: Fixed visual glitches related to blizzard spell effects.

commits.title: feat(waves): add swarm mode
commits.description:
- add a realm-header toggle with countdown and tooltip
- force queued enemies and advance waves below the active-enemy cap
- enforce wave-scaled server cooldowns and reset the mode for new realms

commits.title: balance(combat): revise status and blocking rules
commits.description:
- scale Voodoo poison amplification from 1x at level 1 to 2x at level 99

- make Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks bypass dodge and block

- remove Blocking's reactive cooldown and allow consecutive block rolls

- guarantee Penance restores at least 1% of maximum Mana per successful block

- cap buckler, Katar, and Reflective Surge block chance at 90%

- synchronize combat projections, tooltips, specs, and boundary tests
